facts.fact: Giada 在罗马中央图书馆查到普鲁塔克：Pan 是 demon（中介性存在），若成立则 Peter 不是神
facts.anchor: The problem is that according to Plutarch, Pan was a demon

facts.fact: Secret Base 动员演说以「他们夺走了我们的人生」开头，把成人世界指为抽干大地灵魂的凶手
演说收束：旧世界今夜死去，新世界的封印归 Lost Children；全场静默
facts.anchor: “Tonight the old world dies,” he finishes.

facts.fact: 节庆地点选定 Trastevere，石板巷道直通罗马夜生活的心脏
facts.anchor: Or Trastevere. Its stone alleyways lead to the heart of Roman nights

facts.fact: Peter 穿行人群时每个旁观者看到不同的身体，只有瘾君子认出 satyr 却无力喊叫
facts.anchor: Everyone sees him with a different body: a man, a youth, a child.

facts.fact: 地铁站群仙自称 Good Folk，并要 Peter 先请求许可才能借用其领地
facts.anchor: “Call us Good Folk,” replies Tinker Bell.

facts.fact: Metro（地铁之灵）要求 Pan 以请求者身份取得许可，暗示 Pan 已不是当年统御一切的神
facts.anchor: “Ask me permission,” says Metro, “and I will grant it.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 在新书发布会收到线报：Angela 正赶来，他把她当活饵并令海盗备战
facts.anchor: “Look out—Angela Cavaterra is coming. Make ready!

facts.fact: Wendy 在狂欢顶点冲动告白，Giada 回以同一句，两人随即决定去踢海盗的屁股
facts.anchor: “I love you,” she says, on impulse.

facts.fact: Wendy 把 Aldo Miglio 吊在罗马夜空后松手，让他坠地；此前他只见危险不见 Wonder
章末：Lupercalia 以欢宴与惨败同时收场，终结的种子已经种下
facts.anchor: The seeds of the end have been planted
